## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 355 captures during January 2022. Activity proceeded in line with the expected operational schedule, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. There were no reported changes to the planned delivery of sessions during the month.

The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading results outlined below. These results should be considered alongside the volume of captures completed at the site during January 2022.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 2.5 per cent. The result indicates that most images were of sufficient quality for assessment, while the ungradable images require consideration in routine quality monitoring.

## Grading

Grading identified 69 referable results from the activity completed during January 2022. The median lag between image capture and grading was 17 days. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process and should be monitored with activity and image-quality results.
